effective_rules: Table 352: DP and BDC properties are either an inline property-list dictionary or a name associated with a Properties subdictionary in the current resource dictionary.

§14.6.2: an all-direct property-list dictionary may be inline. If any value is an indirect reference to an object outside the content stream, the property list shall be a named resource in the current Resources/Properties and the DP/BDC operand shall be the name. The rule concerns producer form; malformed inline references do not create an unstated reader rejection duty.
§14.6.2 advises processors to use property entries consistently; this is not an instruction to assign meaning to arbitrary property keys.

Table 97: OCMD Type required; OCGs may be one dictionary or an array and null/deleted refs are ignored; absent/empty/all-null OCGs neutralizes P; P defaults AnyOn with four listed policies; optional VE, if present, takes precedence over OCGs/P. Producer arity/list constraints remain distinct from reader recovery.
